subject.title: feat(android): per-gateway custom headers for gateways behind authenticating proxies

question: Should this Android PR land arbitrary per-gateway credential headers after rebase and real proxy proof, or should the mobile proxy-auth surface be narrowed before Android ships it?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the permanent security boundary controls operator-supplied credentials that are stored locally and replayed before OpenClaw gateway auth.

options.title: Approve after guarded proof
options.body: Keep the arbitrary-header design, require the rebase plus redacted Android authenticated-proxy proof, and let owner/secops review validate the credential lifecycle before merge.

options.title: Narrow to typed proxy auth
options.body: Replace arbitrary name/value headers with a smaller typed proxy-auth contract if maintainers prefer easier validation and redaction across mobile clients.

options.title: Pause Android for shared design
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader mobile and CLI proxy-auth contract is settled in the canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Approve after guarded proof
recommendation.body: Keep the arbitrary-header design, require the rebase plus redacted Android authenticated-proxy proof, and let owner/secops review validate the credential lifecycle before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the linked request and has the strongest current Android gateway/auth history signal for coordinating the security boundary choice.
